retail_game.platform: Xbox 360 retail game running through the Linux guest runtime
retail_game.renderer: project-owned native Vulkan plugin; ReXGlue Xenos GPU emulation disabled

captured_sampler_contract.implementation: Sampler translation maps captured filter and anisotropy state to Vulkan. The plugin passes only provider-enabled features; with the current provider call using with_gpu_emulation=false, samplerAnisotropy is unavailable and safely falls back to 1:1. An additive provider feature request is proposed separately to Process 1.

mixed_sample_path.retail_observation: The live frame changes from 4x MSAA to 1x, then contains 4x depth/stencil-only draws with stencil write mask 0xff. Other captured frames contain 4x no-write draws between 1x draws.
mixed_sample_path.renderer_behavior: Leading 4x draws render into the MSAA attachments and resolve to 1x. Interstitial 4x draws with no framebuffer writes are skipped. A post-transition 4x depth/stencil-only draw is replayed in the resolved 1x depth/stencil attachment only when a later 1x draw consumes depth/stencil; terminal depth/stencil-only writes are skipped because this renderer produces the frame color and does not retain guest depth/stencil across frames. Post-transition 4x color writes still fail closed.
mixed_sample_path.targeted_regression: Synthetic 4x -> 1x -> 4x stencil write -> 1x stencil read verifies the later 1x draw sees the sample-zero-resolved stencil update; a separate regression covers 4x -> 1x -> 4x no-write -> 1x.
mixed_sample_path.retail_verification: Not yet verified with the new replay path. The older plugin produced repeated mixed-sample failures on the captured stencil writer. Fresh launches of the rebuilt plugin exited with status 135 (SIGBUS) before guest PM4 capture, so no retail frame or readback was produced.

remaining_unresolved_draws.reason: pixel shader uses an unsupported Xenos ALU vector opcode; the updated translator now includes opcode and instruction address in the error, but the rebuilt plugin did not reach a guest draw

linux_vulkan_validation.result: Offscreen synthetic regressions passed, including both mixed-sample interleaving cases and the 4:1 sampler path when enabled.

android_arm64.android_cmake_fix: Added the missing Vulkan 1.1 SPIR-V generation for xenos_copy_sample0_single.frag, which the renderer regression executable requires.

redmi_note_8_pro.renderer_regression: Synthetic offscreen 4x-to-1x draw and sample-zero depth/stencil resolve passed.
redmi_note_8_pro.validation_layer: Unavailable on device; this was an execution check without Vulkan validation.

runtime_validation_findings.observation: The live ReXGlue presenter reports these during early swapchain recreation/presentation, before sustained guest draw submissions. They are outside the offscreen renderer core and were sent to Process 1 for separate tracking.

limitations: The synthetic renderer regressions do not establish retail visual parity.
The latest rebuilt plugin has not completed a retail draw because test launches faulted before guest PM4 capture; the cause is undetermined.
Sampler anisotropy remains at 1:1 until ReXGlue exposes an explicit feature request independent of Xenos GPU emulation.
Retail draws 27, 28, and 29 still require shader/texture contract support.
